UserAppState.title: UserAppState
UserAppState.description: User's synchronized task management state, tabs, deleted archive, and preferences.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

email.description: Email address of the authenticated Google user.

settings.description: User preferences such as sound, fire animation, language.

/users/{userId}.description: Private root document for each user state, accessible only by the owner.

/users/{userId}/data/{documentId}.description: Subcollection for user backups and snapshots.
